versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Trading Journal & Performance Analytics skill.
- Enables professional trade journaling with detailed trade, emotion, and discipline tracking.
- Provides advanced performance analytics, including win rate, P&L, drawdown, and strategy effectiveness.
- Supports multi-asset, multi-timeframe trading, with screenshot and tagging features.
- Offers robust emotion logging, psychological insights, and discipline violation analysis.
- Includes export options (CSV, JSON, PDF), cloud sync, and advanced analytics for performance improvement.
